name: finem-ui-ux
description: Design useful, accessible interfaces with coherent visual language, interaction states and motion.

interface.longDescription:
Design, review and polish web and mobile interfaces with nine complete original XYLEX UI skills. This plugin works without Engineering Core.

Included skills: ui-design for implementation and redesign; ui-radar for visual references; anti-ui-slop for product-specific design direction; ui-slop-score for rendered UI reviews; extract-design-system for website tokens; polish-ui-components for component refinement; transitions-dev and transitions-polish for web animation; agentation for a requested development feedback toolbar.

The app exposes these nine specialists plus one Finem entry skill. Every specialist includes its original supporting files. The source is pinned to a Git commit and checked with SHA-256 hashes in ui-source.lock.json; the original MIT license is included.

Expected outcomes: useful flows, coherent layouts and tokens, responsive components, interaction states, appropriate motion and evidence from rendered checks. Choose the relevant specialist rather than running all workflows for every task.

Optional Engineering Core integration adds the broader requirements and engineering workflow, Impeccable, Vercel web guidelines and WCAG audit patterns. These additional Core-backed skills require compatible Core and prerequisite area plugins; they are not part of the standalone bundle.

External UI reference research is optional. Website token extraction needs its separate runtime dependencies. Agentation is added to a project only when requested and is kept development-only. Installing this plugin does not connect accounts, install browser runtimes or alter application code.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for UI/UX & Design System and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review UI/UX & Design System in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
